thread:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — we need to align EdgeWave (HW), NorthGrid (SI), and the cloud marketplace listing for onboarding the open model 'Gaia-Large-v2' before the planned joint announcement on 2024-06-12. Main open items: licensing wording (redistribution vs. service-only), packaging artifacts for marketplace (quantized + full weights?), and marketing embargo. Who can take head of each?
Carlos Ruiz: I can drive the marketplace side. Need to confirm allowed artifact types and whether marketplace accepts quantized-only packages. Also: will we require an MC/SI attestation for deployment?
Jen Park: EdgeWave will not accept raw fp16 weights in their edge store. They want a quantized artifact (4-bit or 8-bit) + signed provenance. They also need the license to allow them to ship a derivative that runs on their hardware appliance (but not redistribute raw checkpoints).
Omar Khan: From runtime perspective, Redwood supports q4_0/q4_8 artifacts and we can produce a marketplace bundle that includes our runtime shim + quantized model. Need to confirm KV cache persistence for edge; also how SI wants to integrate inference APIs.
Leah Rivers: Proposed assignment: Carlos = marketplace packaging & contract language, Jen = HW partner delivery spec + verification, Omar = runtime packaging + integration guide, Sasha = legal check on distribution clause, Ben = announcement & co-branding. Timeline: 2 weeks for legal, 1 week for marketplace gating, 3 weeks for integration testing.
Ben O'Neill: Marketing notes — we need co-brand logos + one-pager by 2024-06-05 to hit the 06-12 announcement. Also ask PR if there's any embargo rules from EdgeWave / NorthGrid. Who owns the press release draft?
Sasha (Legal): High level legal constraints: 1) If EdgeWave wants to ship a product that includes the model weights, license must explicitly permit distribution of the quantized/packaged artifact to customers; 2) If either partner requests redistribution of raw weights, we need export/transfer approvals and a heavier SLA + indemnity. Recommend clause: "Partner may distribute only the integrated, quantized runtime artifact; redistribution of raw model weights (checkpoint files) is prohibited without explicit prior written consent." I'll draft consent language and a simple addendum for the marketplace listing.
Maya Patel: Sasha — can you also add language allowing us to provide a "service-only" fallback (i.e., Redwood-hosted inference) if EdgeWave can't ship weights? That would be a default fallback for customers.
Sasha (Legal): Yes. Addendum will include both options: (A) integrated artifact distribution under partner-limited redistribution; (B) service-only deployment via Redwood for regulated regions. Also adding export control checkbox for marketplace seller form.
Carlos Ruiz: Marketplace gating questions: does the AWS/GCP marketplace accept a license like that? I recall they want a standard distro license or a custom license uploaded. Also need a short SKU description and sample bundle naming.
Omar Khan: Sample bundle we built for internal testing:
```
marketplace_artifact:
  model: gaia-large-v2-q4_8
  runtime: redwood-runtime-1.7.2
  packaging: docker+tar.gz
  license: redwood-edgewave-partner-1.0
  manifest: manifest.json (contains sha256 + provenance)
```
We can produce this as a reproducible build and include signed manifest.
Jen Park: EdgeWave requires a signed manifest and hardware-optimized kernel list. We'll supply a target–optimized kernel package but that may require a short compatibility SLA for older appliances.
Leah Rivers: For integration testing: propose two tracks — "Marketplace seller flow" (Carlos + Omar) and "SI pre-integration" (Jen + NorthGrid). Test matrix: small prompt latency, top-k/response fidelity check, and provenance verification. Target passing date: 2024-06-03.
Ben O'Neill: PR/announcement: suggested messaging — highlight joint end-to-end solution: "EdgeWave appliances running Gaia-Large-v2 via Redwood's runtime, available through marketplace with SI integration options." Need to confirm trademark usage and logo approvals.
Maya Patel: Action items roundup: Sasha to draft license addendum (due 2024-05-20), Carlos to confirm marketplace artifact acceptance and SKU (due 2024-05-22), Jen to finalize EdgeWave delivery spec (due 2024-05-18), Omar to package runtime bundle + manifest (due 2024-05-24), Ben to coordinate logos and PR draft (due 2024-05-25). I'll set a follow-up sync 05-23.
Sasha (Legal): Draft will include the line: "Partner may distribute integrated, quantized runtime artifacts (including signed manifests). Redistribution of raw model checkpoint files is prohibited without Redwood's written approval." Also adding a short export-control clause and a marketplace seller certification checkbox.
Carlos Ruiz: :thumbsup: I'll open the marketplace ticket today and ping once I have confirmation on allowed artifact types.
Omar Khan: I'll start a build pipeline for the q4_8 artifact and include an automated manifest signer. Will post the test image link here when ready.
Jen Park: NorthGrid wants a sandbox instance for integration early next week — can we provide a short-lived dev license for test inference?
Maya Patel: Yes, Omar can provision a sandbox image. Omar — please set TTL and keys.
Omar Khan: Done — provisioning plan created. Deploy-bot: created image gaia-q4-test-20240515, TTL 7 days.
deploy-bot: image gaia-q4-test-20240515 is live in dev-account (link masked).
Leah Rivers: Filing this as the central thread for the launch. I'll convert action items into a shared spreadsheet and invite everyone. Thanks all. :eyes:
Ben O'Neill: I'll draft PR + one-pager and put in the drive. Will tag for review.
Maya Patel: Great progress — thanks team. We'll reconvene 05-23 for final signoffs.
